==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I cast a spell to travel to the source of magic. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The spells I used were Porta and Ligo. Porta opened the portal and Ligo connected the portal to the source of magic.) (The realm of the source of magic resembles a land of tall, rectangular, purple grass and coil shaped, cavernous, red structures. The sky was cream colored with streaks of white clouds.)
There I found myself barraged with riddles by the realm's inhabitants. (The denizens of the realm of the source of magic resemble translucent humanoids wearing psychedelic masks. Some of these humanoids have multiple heads.)
Once I solved the riddle, I discovered I was in the Collective Unconscious.
